method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Oil sinks to three-month low after Trump says US close to Iran deal
Equities.summary: Stocks and government bonds make big gains on hopes energy shock could ease
Equities.reason: Iran peace optimism materially reduces oil-risk premium -> fuels broad risk-on moves and bond rallies; clear macro driver for equity leadership and cross-market flows, high relevance to overall equity regime.

Equities.title: Wall St futures rise on Mideast deal hopes; SpaceX debut in focus
Equities.reason: Combines two dominant market impulses: Mideast de‑risking boosting futures (risk‑on) and the looming SpaceX IPO which is driving rotation and liquidity flows into specific sectors; useful cross-market read for equity positioning.

Equities.title: Luxury stocks spike on proposed U.S.-Iran peace deal; LVMH up 5%
Equities.summary: Luxury stocks have been hard hit by the Iran war, as the Middle East had been a fast-growing market for the otherwise largely muted sector.
Equities.reason: Sector-level confirmation of a risk‑on trade tied to Iran de‑escalation; shows which equity segments capture the upside (luxury, travel/consumer discretionary) — relevant but more idiosyncratic than market-wide.

Equities.title: Musk’s SpaceX raises $75bn in world’s biggest IPO
Equities.summary: Rockets-to-AI group priced its shares at $135 in deal that drew blockbuster investor demand
Equities.reason: Record‑breaking IPO is an extraordinary supply/liquidity event driving rotations, index composition questions, and retail/institutional flows — a market‑structure catalyst with outsized impact on equity sentiment and sectoral leadership.

Equities.title: U.S. equity funds record first weekly outflow in three weeks
Equities.reason: Fund flow data showing near‑term outflows from US equity funds is a counterbalance to sentiment headlines; implies caution on breadth and highlights potential fragility in the rally.

Equities.title: Wholesale prices rose 1.1% in May, more than expected, on surge in energy
Equities.summary: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.7% in May, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.
Equities.reason: Hot PPI print raises sticky‑inflation risk and potential for rate repricing — negative for growth multiple and risk appetite; important macro headwind for equities despite risk‑on headlines.

Equities.title: ‘Extreme’ Rotations Leave Stock Market Bulls Without a Playbook
Equities.reason: Coverage of violent sector/size rotations highlights market instability and rising dispersion — a negative for consensus long‑only positioning and signal that leadership is narrow and fickle.

Equities.title: Global equity funds draw third weekly inflow as investors buy the dip
Equities.reason: Broad global fund inflows indicate dip‑buying behavior and support for risk assets outside the US; reinforces the view of a risk‑on backdrop driven by de‑risking in the Middle East and search for yield/assets.

Rates.title: Monetary policy decisions

Rates.title: For Warsh as Fed chair, silence may be the point
Rates.summary: Kevin Warsh will hold his first Fed meeting, giving markets the first public look at how he'll communicate as chair of the Federal Reserve.
Rates.reason: Change in Fed leadership and first meetings can shift forward guidance and market rate expectations. The article implies a communication/stance risk that could lean hawkish, pressuring U.S. yields higher — material but somewhat uncertain, so medium relevance.

Rates.title: India Inflation Accelerates to 3.93%, Stays Below RBI Target
Rates.reason: Headline CPI remaining below the RBI target is supportive for Indian government bonds (reduces near‑term rate‑hike pressure). Directly relevant to local yield trajectory and flows into INR‑rates, so positive for bond prices.

Rates.title: Several Indonesian Bond Funds Delay Redemptions After Turmoil
Rates.reason: Redemption freezes point to liquidity stress in Indonesian bond market and potential forced selling, which is negative for local sovereign and corporate bond prices and could widen spreads — meaningful regional rates risk.

Rates.title: Higher Costs for Plastics Used Everywhere Are Becoming Next Inflation Headache
Rates.reason: Rising input costs for widely used materials can feed through to core inflation and keep policy rates higher-for-longer; a modestly negative signal for bond prices (higher yields) but more sectoral/gradual, so moderate relevance.

Rates.title: South Africa Treasury Says Upgrades Show Path to Investment Grade
Rates.reason: Official comments that credit upgrades point toward investment‑grade status are constructive for South African sovereign spreads and bond demand; positive for bond prices but more credit‑specific than systemic, so moderate relevance.
